versions.changelog:
Initial release of UberFix Branch Finder.

- Find and list UberFix service branches using the operational API.
- Provides tools to list all registered branches or locate the nearest one using geographic coordinates.
- Requires user location or city name for nearby branch lookups.
- Clarifies backend requirements: use "latitude"/"longitude" (not "lat"/"lng"), only show limited, authorized data.
- Distances shown are geographic estimates—do not infer travel time, branch status, or eligibility unless specified by backend.
